verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's CKS API supports create/list/update/delete of clusters and node pools, autoscaling scales node pools to match demand, and Spot/On-Demand node pools offer pay-as-you-go pricing without long-term commitment, which together approximate elastic, pay-for-what-you-use provisioning. However, the evidence describes lifecycle control at the cluster/node-pool level (via Kubernetes/Terraform/API), not explicit per-instance start/stop/restart/terminate operations, and no billing granularity confirming pay-only-for-running-time is shown beyond general billing insights. Missing for 10: explicit instance-level start/stop/restart API semantics, and concrete billing evidence tying cost directly to running-state duration.
